facts.fact: The vendor states that over 50 million monthly active users in the US watch content through Fire TV devices.
facts.quote: Over 50 million monthly active users in the US watch content through Fire TV devices.

facts.fact: The vendor states that in 2024 Amazon introduced ads to Prime Video.
facts.quote: In 2024, Amazon introduced ads to Prime Video, creating one of the largest ad-supported streaming audiences overnight.

facts.fact: The vendor states that over 200 million global Prime members now see ads on Prime Video unless they pay an additional fee to remove them.
facts.quote: Over 200 million global Prime members now see ads unless they pay an additional fee to remove them.

facts.fact: The vendor states that Amazon DSP managed service typically requires a minimum spend of $50,000 or more.
facts.quote: **Managed service:** $50,000+ minimum spend

facts.fact: The vendor states that Amazon DSP self-service minimum varies but is often $35,000 or more.
facts.quote: **Self-service:** Minimum varies, but often $35,000+

facts.fact: The vendor states that Fire TV standard demographic targeting CPMs typically range from $25 to $35.
facts.quote: **Standard demographic targeting:** $25-35 CPM

facts.fact: The vendor states that Fire TV Amazon shopper targeting CPMs typically range from $35 to $50.
facts.quote: **Amazon shopper targeting:** $35-50 CPM (premium for the data)

facts.fact: The vendor states that Fire TV Prime Video inventory CPMs typically range from $30 to $45.
facts.quote: **Prime Video inventory:** $30-45 CPM

facts.fact: The vendor states that Adwave lets advertisers access streaming inventory including Fire TV starting at $30 a day.
facts.quote: you can access streaming inventory (including Fire TV) starting at just $30 a day.

facts.fact: The vendor states that Amazon DSP is best for large advertisers with $50,000+ budgets.
facts.quote: Best for large advertisers with $50,000+ budgets who want full access to Amazon's targeting capabilities.

facts.fact: The vendor states that Fire TV video ads are 15 or 30 seconds long, with 30 seconds preferred for storytelling.
facts.quote: **Video length:** 15 or 30 seconds (30 preferred for storytelling)

facts.fact: The vendor states that Fire TV ad resolution requires a minimum of 1920x1080 (HD).
facts.quote: **Resolution:** 1920x1080 (HD) minimum

facts.fact: The vendor states that Fire TV ads use a 16:9 aspect ratio and accept MP4 or MOV file formats.
facts.quote: **Aspect ratio:** 16:9

facts.fact: The vendor recommends showing the brand in the first 5 seconds of Fire TV creative.
facts.quote: **Early branding:** Show your brand in the first 5 seconds

facts.fact: The vendor describes Freevee as formerly known as IMDb TV.
facts.quote: Formerly IMDb TV, Freevee is Amazon's free, ad-supported streaming service.

facts.fact: Agency fees for managing Amazon Fire TV campaigns are typically 15-20% of budget, charged on top of media spend.
facts.quote: Expect agency fees on top of media spend, typically 15-20% of budget.

facts.fact: The minimum budget for Amazon DSP access to Fire TV advertising is $35,000-50,000+.
facts.quote: | Amazon DSP | $35,000-50,000+ | Full access | Enterprise |

facts.fact: Adwave's programmatic access method for Fire TV advertising has a minimum budget of $30 per day.
facts.quote: | Programmatic (Adwave) | $30/day | No (geo/demo only) | Small business |

facts.fact: The minimum budget for agency-managed Fire TV advertising access is $5,000-10,000+.
facts.quote: | Agency | $5,000-10,000+ | Varies by agency | Mid-size |

facts.fact: Some agencies offer Amazon DSP access for Fire TV advertising at minimums of around $10,000 to $15,000.
facts.quote: Some agencies offer Amazon DSP access at lower thresholds (around $10,000 to $15,000).

facts.fact: Through Amazon DSP, Fire TV advertising requires broadcast-quality video creative.
facts.quote: Through Amazon DSP, yes. You'll need broadcast-quality video creative.

facts.fact: Fire TV supports video ads in streaming content, sponsored screensavers, and display ads on the Fire TV home screen.
facts.quote: Fire TV supports video ads that appear in streaming content, sponsored screensavers, and display ads on the Fire TV home screen.

facts.fact: Amazon Attribution can connect Fire TV ads to Amazon sales for sellers who sell products on Amazon.
facts.quote: If you sell products on Amazon, Amazon Attribution can connect your Fire TV ads to Amazon sales.
